invite.copyFailed: The link could not be copied. Select it and copy it by hand.
invite.hint: Anyone with this link can join with a character of the same game. Change the code to stop old links working.
invite.rotateBody: Links you already sent stop working.
invite.title: Invite players
join.invalid: The link may be old: ask your game master for a new one.
join.noCharacters: You have no character for this game yet. Make one in RMHCharacters, then open the link again.
join.seesBody: Everyone in the party sees your character’s name, class and level, armor class, hit points, conditions, Perception, speed and initiative bonus. They never see your portrait, notes, backstory, inventory or money. You can leave at any time.
join.share: Let the game master open my full sheet
join.shareHint: Off unless you turn it on. When on, only the game master can open your whole sheet, read only. Your private notes and portrait are never sent. You can turn it off on the party page.
join.title: Join {{name}}
manage.deleteBody: The party and its turn order are removed. Your players keep their characters.
manage.title: Manage
parties.empty: Start one above and send its link to your players, or open a link a game master sent you.
parties.intro: A party gathers the characters at your table. Everyone in it sees each character’s armor class, hit points, conditions, Perception, speed and initiative; the game master keeps the turn order.
parties.loadFailed: Your parties could not be loaded.
parties.title: Parties
player.leaveBody: The party stops seeing your character and the game master loses access to your sheet.
player.share: Let the game master open my full sheet
player.shareHint: Off by default. Only the game master can open it, read only, and never your notes or portrait. Turn it off any time.
player.title: Your character in this party
sheet.note: Private notes and the portrait are never shared.
sheet.title: Sheet of {{name}} (read only)
sheet.unavailable: This sheet is not available. The player may have stopped sharing it or left the party.
table.caption: Characters in this party
table.unavailable: This character could not be read.
turn.extraName: Name of an extra, for example Goblin 1
turn.hint: Players read this and see changes within about twenty seconds.
turn.title: Turn order
turn.unsaved: Save the order before moving to the next turn.
view.noMembers: No one has brought a character yet. Send the invite link to your players.

view.unavailable: This party is not available. You may have left it, or it was deleted.
